ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;

END;

PROCEDURE proc_don IS
v_local_time date;
v_rb_week_day varchar2(3);
 CURSOR C1 is
 SELECT distinct donation_type_group, proc_code
 FROM fixed_site_hours
 WHERE site_id = :control_block.s_site_id 
 and week_day = :week_days.rb_week_day 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 ORDER by donation_type_group, proc_code ;
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('control_block_1'); 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 FOR C1_rec in C1
 LOOP
 :control_block_1.donation_type_group := c1_rec.donation_type_group;
 :control_block_1.proc_code := c1_rec.proc_code;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record; 
END;
